pages.title: Life-Spark Capsule
pages.text: The <item>Life-Spark capsule/$ creates an <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/cloning#process)embryo/$ from a <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/syringe#blood)blood pouch/$ or <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/blood_centrifuge)centrifuged blood pouch/$, as part of the <thing>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/cloning)cloning process/$.$(br2)Ingredients have to be added to the <item>Life-Spark capsule/$ using either a <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/syringe#embryo_lab)syringe/$ or a dispenser. If adding items using a <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/syringe#embryo_lab)syringe/$, hold the <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/syringe#embryo_lab)syringe/$ in the main hand and the item being

added in the offhand, and right click.$(br2)The blood sample must be added first.$(br2)Additional items can be added to add special <thing>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/traits)traits/$.$(br2)To finalize the crafting, a lightning rod/<item>$(l:essentials:fluid/dynamo#lightning_rod)lightning rod/$ extension on top of the <item>Life-Spark capsule/$ needs to be hit by lightning- any direct strike by lightning (such as a <thing>$(l:essentials:beam/charge)charge beam/$) will work. This will consume all the ingredients and

create one <thing>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/spoilage)fresh/$ <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/cloning#process)embryo/$.$(br2)<thing>$(l:essentials/circuits)Circuits/$ read 1 if there is a <item>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/blood_centrifuge)centrifuged blood pouch/$ in the machine, otherwise 0.$(br2)
